name: Uninstally
soft_passes: #4 broom silhouette survives at 16px but thin bristle strokes merge to a paddle and the two smaller sparkles vanish
#8 only two planes, no micro-shadow under the glyph, so the broom reads as a flat sticker rather than the era's 2-3 lit planes
#2 optically balanced across the diagonal but the broom is large and its handle tip runs near the upper-right safe-zone margin
failures: #1 squircle mask AND drop-shadow baked into the artwork on a transparent canvas (corner alpha 0, outer shadow alpha ~23) rather than a square unmasked layer for the system to mask/shadow; double-shadows and risks corner mismatch under macOS 26
#10 white glyph depends entirely on the violet field for contrast and the mark is a single flat raster, not separable Icon Composer layers, so dark/clear/tinted variants cannot render legibly
light_model: top-down ambient; background gradient lighter at top; no specular, no glass edge highlight; flat opaque glyph with zero self-shadow; one baked soft drop-shadow outside the squircle emulating the system shadow
layer_stack: white broom glyph (diagonal, handle upper-right -> brush lower-left)
three white four-point sparkles (upper-left, scaling large->small)
devices: diagonal broom as the Big Sur tool-at-an-angle crossing the squircle (TextEdit/Preview lineage)
sparkle trail scaling large->small off the brush (the sparkle-clean motif)
monochrome white glyph on a single-hue saturated violet field, no competing accent
rhymes_hint: cleaner/maintenance-utility marks (CleanMyMac lineage: broom + sparkles on a saturated field), Big Sur diagonal-tool squircles (TextEdit/Preview), and single-hue-ramp + white-glyph utility icons
notes: Genuine 1024x1024 PNG, crisp, not a web-resize; hex/geometry reliable. Load-bearing caveat: the icon BAKES the squircle mask + drop-shadow (corner alpha 0, outer shadow alpha ~23) - the Big Sur convention macOS 26 HIG discourages, and the root of both failures + the clearest 'authored pre-Liquid-Glass' tell in the corpus so far. Brand coherence strong: same violet ~#6B4FE0 is the app accent across the cover (headline highlight, feature glyphs, trash-can rim glow). Metaphor split worth noting: the ICON says broom+sparkle (cleaning) while the COVER hero says trash-can-full-of-apps (removal) - two metaphors for one product; the icon took the friendlier one. Broom-for-cleaner is category-expected/template-adjacent; the sparkle trail + era-native diagonal posture are what lift it above generic glyph-on-gradient.
